independent.scope: Six original complete-call files audited once by the unchanged public-only checker frozen before this corpus. All262 original origin/call/end times retained; no private pilot diagnostics supplied.

mechanics.kind: six physical source sockets repeated through alternating mirror sectors
mechanics.reflection: Odd sectors swap the two columns, reverse the source quarter turn modulo four and use the genuinely mirrored glyph. Every whole-sector rotation transforms both centers and glyph vertices.
mechanics.acceptance: CHECK/A freshly compares the structural order and all occupied/empty cells, glyph identities, quarter turns and mirror flags across the whole plate. Window feedback is current information, never accumulated credit.
mechanics.controls: Directions move the bounded 3 by 3 focus board. A places or turns a source glyph, advances ORDER/GLYPH, or submits CHECK. B refunds a source glyph, moves ORDER/GLYPH backward, or clears CHECK. Fresh edges only; held controls do not repeat.
mechanics.stock: Only physical source pieces spend stock. Mirror copies spend no stock; rotation and order changes conserve source pieces. Clear refunds all pieces while preserving order, palette, focus and rejection history.
mechanics.clockAndAttempts: No deadline. Active elapsed time is informational and bounded. Four actual rejected submissions lose; a correct full key can win after three rejections.
mechanics.ordinaryPilot: The frozen pilot consumes current public source, target window, palette, stock and focus information through ordinary acknowledged input edges. It does not load a prepared solution or use future-state simulation.
